title: Dogfood the orchestrator on its own downstream work
body: Plan 2026-05-09-003 just closed; the orchestrator now has the substrate to consume its own state-projection output. Rather than hand-code plans 010 + 004, drive them through supervisor.dispatch_volley and treat every terminal-non-success as signal for orchestrator improvement. Convention follows the harness_frictions_v1/v2 pattern from memory: real volleys surface real frictions; clustered findings get promoted to v3 fixes plan. Parent meta-plan structure follows nested-orchestration v1 (plan 2026-05-02-003): children declare orchestration block pointing up to this parent; parent is a regular plan that gets pointed at. spawn_reason: operator_manual on both children (operator deliberately authored both as downstream work after plan 003 closed).

title: Plan 004 goal_type new_feature → infra (avoid objective_contract overhead)
body: Plan 004 is adapter wiring on top of the state-projection contract shipped by plan 003. It does not introduce a new user-facing surface — the dashboard already exists in axiom/packages/dashboard/. Treating it as infra avoids the Goal Governance V1 objective_contract document requirement at lock time. Same framing as plan 010 (printing-press-adapter skill) and plan 003 (state-projection v0).

title: Plan 010 + plan 004 amended with child orchestration blocks (locked-plan metadata addition is structural, not scope)
body: Plan 010 was already status:active when this parent was drafted. Adding the orchestration + child_charter + commit_policy blocks to its plan.md frontmatter is metadata, not a change to the locked AC (features.json + acceptance text untouched). Per the scope-change protocol: explicitly flagged that locked frontmatter was edited; locked behavioral contract preserved. Plan 004 was draft so its frontmatter is freely editable. Both children now declare parent_plan_id = 2026-05-11-001-infra-state-projection-adapters-meta with spawn_reason: operator_manual.
